annotations.title: Is this text AI-written? AI text detector

description: AI text detector: check pasted text or code (up to 16,000 characters, 30 languages) for AI. Returns an AI-likelihood score with the reasons behind it (300+ characters, about 100 for Chinese, Japanese or Korean), flags chatbot leftovers such as ChatGPT citation tags and unfilled placeholders, and quotes any statement of AI use or named AI tool (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Copilot) word for word. Use for: is this essay, email, post, review or code written by AI or ChatGPT? A score is an estimate, not proof of authorship. Private: no public report is created. Docs: https://isgenai.com/developers/mcp

kind.description: Use code for source code. Defaults to text.
